thread:
Mina R.: quick flag-sync weirdness during today's rollout: console shows `rollout.rev=12` but a small fraction of edge clients are still using rev=10. spotted across two regions.
Sean D.: do we have request/response headers from those clients?
Mina R.: yes — got a sample. client request had `If-None-Match: W/\"10-zzz\"` and proxy returned 304 with no body, but also set `X-Seq: 12`. client treats 304 as no-change (keeps rev10) because we only compare ETag.
Liu W.: ah right — last refactor added `X-Seq` to help debugging but we never taught proxies to preserve extra headers on 304s.
ops-bot: alert: flag-sync-anomaly (flag=experiment-beta, rate=0.0018) -> INC-4990
Sean D.: proposal: (A) edge-client: on 304, if response includes `X-Seq` compare vs local seq; if mismatch, do a `GET` to fetch full payload. (B) proxy: forward `X-Seq` and `X-Seq-Prev` on 304 responses. (C) metrics: emit `flag.sync.mismatch` (tags: env, flag, region, reason=seq_mismatch). (D) console: add a small 'sync' badge + tooltip showing last sync time and last seq seen.
Mina R.: tests: unit test for 304->GET fallback, integration job that flips seq header and asserts client updates within 5s, and a synthetic canary runner that ramps in staging.
Liu W.: ops-runbook temporary check:
```
# quick scan
curl -sI https://edge-proxy.eu/internal/flags/experiment-beta | egrep -i 'ETag|X-Seq' || true
# if proxy missing X-Seq on 304 -> restart proxy or deploy passthrough patch
```
Sean D.: alerting thresholds suggestion: any single-region mismatch_rate > 0.05% over 10m -> page @owners; global > 0.01% over 15m -> escalate. also auto-pause rollouts if mismatch_rate > 0.1% for >5m (config: console.safemode.pause_on_sync_drift=true).
Mina R.: rollout plan: land client change + proxy fix, canary in ap-southeast-1 at 10% for 30m, monitor `flag.sync.mismatch` and `flag.sync.fetch(reason=304_retry)`. if green, expand to 50% then 100% over 2h.
Liu W.: will add a Grafana tile: Flag Sync Integrity (per-flag heatmap) + a small dashboard that surfaces recent 304_retry counts.
Sean D.: I'll open two PRs: edge-client fallback + proxy header passthrough. include compatibility tests for older proxies. Mina, can you wire the console badge?
Mina R.: yup — minimal UI shipped behind `console.feature.sync_health=true`. Product okayed a small tooltip.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: edge-client v1.14.0 -> ap-southeast-1 (10%)
Mina R.: leaving a follow-up note in #postmortems after 24h of telemetry. tagging @Sean D. and @Liu W. Thanks :thumbsup:
